# Hatchly

> Hatchly is a cozy habit and wellness app with an AI pet companion. Stay healthy, gain a cuddle buddy.

Website: https://hatchly.me
Discord: https://discord.gg/ytvfBajAhh
Closed beta: September 21, 2026
Waitlist: https://hatchly.me/#beta-signup
Share image: https://hatchly.me/og-image.png (Wisp, sleepy AI pet companion)
Square image: https://hatchly.me/og-image-square.png

## What Hatchly is

Hatchly combines gentle real-life health tracking with a cute AI pet and an Animal Crossing–style cozy multiplayer game world.

Core wellness features:
- AI chatting with your pet for supportive check-ins
- Food / eating habit logging
- Weight logging
- Mood diary and notes
- Habit tracking for water, food, mood, and movement
- Pet progress tied to showing up (XP, sleepy when you miss days — not punitive)

Core game features:
- Realtime multiplayer island
- Farming
- Fishing
- Bug catching
- Cooking
- Crafting
- Live item trading with other players

## Who it is for

People who want habit tracking that feels playful instead of clinical — especially anyone motivated by pets, cozy games, soft accountability, and multiplayer social play.
